title: New Tablets and Fear of God

questions.question: What did God command Moses to cut?
options: Two tablets of stone like the first
questions.correctAnswer: Two tablets of stone like the first
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:1 (ESV): "At that time the LORD said to me, ‘Cut for yourself two tablets of stone like the first...’"

questions.question: What did Moses make to put the tablets in?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:3 (ESV): "So I made an ark of acacia wood and cut two tablets of stone..."

questions.question: Who died at Moserah?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:6 (ESV): "...There Aaron died, and there he was buried..."

questions.question: Which tribe was set apart to carry the ark?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:8 (ESV): "At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant..."

questions.question: What does the Lord require of Israel?
options: To fear Him, walk in His ways, love Him, and serve Him
questions.correctAnswer: To fear Him, walk in His ways, love Him, and serve Him
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:12 (ESV): "...what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, to serve the LORD..."

questions.question: What should be circumcised?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:16 (ESV): "Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no longer stubborn."

questions.question: God is described as not being partial and what else?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:17 (ESV): "...who is not partial and takes no bribe."

questions.question: Who should you love because you were strangers in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:19 (ESV): "Love the sojourner, therefore, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt."

questions.question: To whom do the heaven and the heaven of heavens belong?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:14 (ESV): "Behold, to the Lord your God belong heaven and the heaven of heavens..."

questions.question: What is Levi's inheritance?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:9 (ESV): "Therefore Levi has no portion or inheritance with his brothers. The Lord is his inheritance..."

questions.question: Your fathers went down to Egypt with how many persons?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:22 (ESV): "Your fathers went down to Egypt seventy persons..."

questions.question: Where were the tablets placed?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:5 (ESV): "...and put the tablets in the ark that I had made. And there they are..."

questions.question: Who ministered in the priest's office after Aaron died?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:6 (ESV): "...and Eleazar his son ministered as priest in his place."

questions.question: Why did God listen to Moses "at that time also"?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:10 (ESV): "...And the Lord listened to me at that time also. The Lord was unwilling to destroy you."

questions.question: God serves justice for whom?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 10:18 (ESV): "He executes justice for the fatherless and the widow..."

key_verse_text: And now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul. (ESV)
